Run the approved focused tests, compile check, diff check, and release-content comparison against the manifest.
Set release ownership and read-only permissions, apply the project-approved immutable attribute policy, then read back mode, owner, resolved path, manifest hash, and immutable state.
Point the user unit to the exact release path and perform a same-run PID, cwd, command, health, readiness, and public-route readback while preserving the prior release.
rollback_prerequisites: A separately preserved prior Stage-2 release with its own manifest, commit/hash identity, immutable readback, and known-good health/readiness receipt.
A captured service-unit and route configuration snapshot plus an authorized rollback owner and maintenance window.
Verified compatibility of the prior release with the existing stage2.sqlite3 state, or a tested recoverable state backup and migration rollback plan.
A rollback runbook that restores the prior exact path, verifies PID/cwd/command, runs local and public health/readiness checks, and records the result before any recovery claim.

findings.detail: The active user unit and health endpoints are real and healthy, but the target directory is a mutable copy without an independent Git HEAD, release manifest, per-file release ledger, or immutable i flag. The active assembly cannot be bound to an authoritative source identity or a recoverable release identity.

All 8 hardening implementation files differ between the candidate worktree and production release, and both new hardening tests are absent from production. The live service therefore cannot be credited with the candidate hardening content.

The candidate branch HEAD is 78120eea..., while the worktree carries uncommitted hardening and untracked tests. The handoff document states an older ed5dc396... baseline. There is no single immutable identity for the proposed hardening to promote.

The deployed browser evidence is marked verification VERIFIED but formalAcceptance NOT_ACCEPTED, was generated before the current service start, and has no top-level release hash or PID binding. It is not same-run proof of the current assembly.
The targeted releases sibling listing showed no prior openclaw-stage2 release directory. A rollback target, immutable receipt, and state-compatibility proof were not observed.

remaining_risks: The service can remain healthy while serving older or mixed Stage-2 code because readiness does not identify the release content.
The mutable release directory and parent-home Git layout allow provenance drift without a release-level audit trail.
The production process references secret-bearing EnvironmentFile paths; values were intentionally not read, so configuration completeness was not assessed.
The release contains a writable SQLite state file path and no demonstrated state backup/rollback receipt.
The current result covers source/provenance and production assembly only and does not change the formal SSOT state.
